paras: Upgrade your BMW M2, M3 or M4's rear braking performance with Dixcel brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel PD Type rear rotor for the BMW M2 (F87, 2016-2021) , M3 (F80, 2014-2018) and M4 (F82/F83, 2014-2020) fitted with the factory blue caliper brakes , covering the 3.0L N55 (M2) and 3.0L S55 twin-turbo (M2 Competition / CS, M3, M4) variants, with 370x24mm rear discs . The PD Type is Dixcel's standard replacement rotor, made to tighter tolerances than factory and finished with an anti-rust coating for quiet, consistent everyday braking.
